world.story:
Little Red Riding Hood skipped along the woodland path, carrying a basket of cake and a corked bottle for Grandmother.

A charcoal-gray wolf stepped from the ferns. “Where are you going?” he asked sweetly.

Red pointed toward the cottage. “Grandmother isn’t feeling well.”

“Then take her some flowers,” suggested the wolf. While Red wandered among the blossoms, he hurried away.

At the cottage, he imitated Red’s voice. Grandmother opened the door. Before she could escape, he swallowed her whole! Then he pulled on her white nightcap and climbed into bed.

Red arrived and set her basket on the table. She approached the bed, clutching her cape.

“Grandmother, what big ears you have!”

“All the better to hear you with.”

“What big eyes you have!”

“All the better to see you with.”

Red backed away, trembling. “What big teeth you have!”

“All the better to eat you with!”

The wolf leaped from bed and swallowed her. With his belly round, he lay down and snored.

A passing huntsman heard the dreadful noise. Inside, he spotted the nightcap and understood. Taking sewing scissors from the shelf, he carefully snipped open the sleeping wolf’s belly.

Red scrambled out, gasping, followed by Grandmother. They clung together, shaking with relief.

Red fetched six heavy stones from outside. The huntsman placed them inside the wolf and stitched him closed with a threaded needle.

The wolf woke and tried to flee, but the stones dragged him down. He fell dead beside the bed.

Red hugged Grandmother tightly. Together they shared the cake with their rescuer, and Red promised never to stray from the path again.

marks.name: Winding woodland path
marks.size: Wide enough for two grown people to walk abreast.
marks.faces: Runs away from the camera and divides into left and right branches.
marks.where: From centre foreground to centre middle, dividing beside the flowers and ferns.
marks.intended: From centre foreground to centre middle, dividing beside the flowers and ferns.

marks.name: Near stretch of path
marks.size: Two grown people wide, with several walking strides visible.
marks.faces: Toward the fork at centre middle.
marks.where: Centre foreground, continuing unobstructed to path.fork.
marks.intended: Centre foreground, continuing unobstructed to path.fork.

marks.name: Path junction
marks.size: An open patch wide enough for a grown person and a child to stop together.
marks.faces: Divides toward the left ferns and the right-hand cottage.
marks.where: Centre middle, beyond path.near, with flowers to its left and the cottage branch to its right.
marks.intended: Centre middle, beyond path.near, with flowers to its left and the cottage branch to its right.

marks.name: Fern branch
marks.size: About one grown person wide.
marks.faces: Curves left and disappears away from the camera among the ferns.
marks.where: From the left edge of path.fork through left middle to left far.
marks.intended: From the left edge of path.fork through left middle to left far.

marks.name: Cottage branch
marks.size: Wide enough for two people to pass.
marks.faces: Curves right and away from the camera toward garden-gate.
marks.where: From the right edge of path.fork across centre-right middle to the garden entrance at right far.
marks.intended: From the right edge of path.fork across centre-right middle to the garden entrance at right far.

marks.name: Fern thicket
marks.size: Mostly waist high on a grown person, dense enough to conceal a crouching wolf.
marks.where: Left middle and left far, bordering path.ferns; the nearest fronds reach the left edge of path.fork without blocking it.
marks.intended: Left middle and left far, bordering path.ferns; the nearest fronds reach the left edge of path.fork without blocking it.

marks.name: Wildflower verge
marks.size: Ankle- to knee-high flowers in a patch several child-sized steps across.
marks.where: Centre-left middle beside path.fork, on the camera-near side of path.ferns; a clear grassy edge allows a child to stand among the blossoms.
marks.intended: Centre-left middle beside path.fork, on the camera-near side of path.ferns; a clear grassy edge allows a child to stand among the blossoms.

marks.name: Tall woodland oaks
marks.size: Many times a grown person's height, with broad trunks and a high canopy.
marks.where: Along the left foreground edge and across the far background; trunks remain clear of the path branches and the cottage entrance.
marks.intended: Along the left foreground edge and across the far background; trunks remain clear of the path branches and the cottage entrance.

marks.name: Grandmother's cottage exterior
marks.size: A small, single-storey cottage, with an entrance tall enough for the huntsman.
marks.faces: Its entrance-bearing wall faces the camera across the garden.
marks.where: Right far at the edge of the sunny clearing, behind garden-wall; its entrance remains plainly visible.
marks.intended: Right far at the edge of the sunny clearing, behind garden-wall; its entrance remains plainly visible.

marks.name: Cottage entrance, exterior
marks.size: A grown-person-height doorway, wide enough for the huntsman.
marks.faces: Opens away from the outdoor camera, inward into the cottage.
marks.where: On the cottage's camera-facing wall at right far, at the end of garden-path.
marks.intended: On the cottage's camera-facing wall at right far, at the end of garden-path.

marks.name: Low stone garden wall
marks.size: About knee high on a grown person.
marks.where: Around the cottage garden at right far; its camera-near stretch has an opening for garden-gate, with short returns beside the cottage.
marks.intended: Around the cottage garden at right far; its camera-near stretch has an opening for garden-gate, with short returns beside the cottage.

marks.name: Garden gate
marks.size: Knee high and wide enough for a grown person to pass comfortably.
marks.faces: Opens inward into the garden, resting beside the wall rather than across garden-path.
marks.where: In the camera-near stretch of garden-wall at right far, directly between path.cottage and garden-path.
marks.intended: In the camera-near stretch of garden-wall at right far, directly between path.cottage and garden-path.

marks.name: Short garden approach
marks.size: One grown person wide, with room to stand at the cottage door.
marks.faces: Leads away from the camera from garden-gate to cottage.door.
marks.where: Inside garden-wall at right far, between the gate and the cottage entrance; unobstructed throughout.
marks.intended: Inside garden-wall at right far, between the gate and the cottage entrance; unobstructed throughout.

marks.name: Bare patch for the loose stones
marks.size: A small bare-earth patch, large enough for six fist-sized stones and a crouching child beside them.
marks.where: Right middle, immediately outside garden-wall and just to the right of garden-gate; reachable from path.cottage without crossing the wall.
marks.intended: Right middle, immediately outside garden-wall and just to the right of garden-gate; reachable from path.cottage without crossing the wall.

woodland.camera: Fixed eye-level wide view from the near end of the woodland path, looking toward the fork and sunny clearing. The fern branch is on the left; the cottage and its entrance are visible at the right edge.

cottage.light: Golden light enters through the central window, leaving soft, cozy shadows around the hearth and bed. Watercolor with delicate ink outlines, woodland greens and warm crimson curtains.

marks.name: Cottage entrance, interior
marks.size: A grown-person-height doorway, wide enough for the huntsman.
marks.faces: Opens inward toward the foreground, resting against the left wall and leaving the central aisle clear.
marks.where: In the left wall near the foreground, well forward of hearth.
marks.intended: In the left wall near the foreground, well forward of hearth.

marks.name: Central window
marks.size: About a grown person's arm span wide, with its sill just above table.
marks.faces: Faces into the room toward the camera; glazing remains closed.
marks.where: Centre far, set into the back wall directly above table.
marks.intended: Centre far, set into the back wall directly above table.

marks.name: Left crimson curtain
marks.size: Runs from above the window to just below its sill.
marks.faces: Drawn to the left, leaving the glazing exposed.
marks.where: Against the back wall immediately left of window, above the left end of table and clear of hearth.
marks.intended: Against the back wall immediately left of window, above the left end of table and clear of hearth.

marks.name: Right crimson curtain
marks.size: Runs from above the window to just below its sill.
marks.faces: Drawn to the right, leaving the glazing exposed.
marks.where: Against the back wall immediately right of window, above table and clear of sewing-shelf.
marks.intended: Against the back wall immediately right of window, above table and clear of sewing-shelf.

marks.name: Small wooden table
marks.size: Waist high on a grown person, about an arm span wide and half an arm span deep.
marks.faces: Its long front edge faces the camera.
marks.where: Centre far, beneath window and against the back wall; open standing space remains in front and beside it.
marks.intended: Centre far, beneath window and against the back wall; open standing space remains in front and beside it.

marks.name: Tabletop
marks.size: Large enough for Red's basket and a modest meal for three.
marks.faces: Horizontal, facing upward.
marks.where: On top of table, below the window sill, with its near edge accessible from the central aisle.
marks.intended: On top of table, below the window sill, with its near edge accessible from the central aisle.

marks.name: Built-in sewing shelf
marks.size: Waist high on a grown person, about one grown person's shoulder width across, and shallow enough to reach its back.
marks.faces: Its open storage recess faces the camera; its working surface faces upward.
marks.where: Centre-right far, built into the back wall immediately right of table and left of bed.head. This is the storage position for sewing scissors and a threaded needle.
marks.intended: Centre-right far, built into the back wall immediately right of table and left of bed.head. This is the storage position for sewing scissors and a threaded needle.

marks.name: Stone hearth
marks.size: About a grown person's arm span wide, with a low stone apron and a waist-high fireplace opening.
marks.faces: The opening faces diagonally toward centre foreground.
marks.where: Far left in the back-left corner, clear of the entrance door's swing and separated from table by a strip of bare wall.
marks.intended: Far left in the back-left corner, clear of the entrance door's swing and separated from table by a strip of bare wall.

marks.name: Wooden bed
marks.size: A little longer than a grown person lying down, wide enough for the large wolf and his rounded belly; mattress about knee high.
marks.faces: Head toward the back wall, foot toward the camera.
marks.where: On the right, running from the far back wall toward the middle foreground, with its right long side against the right wall.
marks.intended: On the right, running from the far back wall toward the middle foreground, with its right long side against the right wall.

marks.name: Head of the bed
marks.size: The full width of the bed, with a headboard about waist high on a grown person.
marks.faces: The headboard's inner face points toward the camera and bed.foot.
marks.where: Right far, against the back wall and just right of sewing-shelf; the pillow lies at this end.
marks.intended: Right far, against the back wall and just right of sewing-shelf; the pillow lies at this end.

marks.name: Foot of the bed
marks.size: The full width of the bed, with a low footboard below mattress-top level.
marks.faces: Points toward the foreground, opposite bed.head.
marks.where: Right middle, at the camera-near end of bed, with clear floor between it and the camera.
marks.intended: Right middle, at the camera-near end of bed, with clear floor between it and the camera.

marks.name: Accessible side of the bed
marks.size: A full grown-person-length edge, at knee height.
marks.faces: Faces left toward the centre of the room.
marks.where: Along the left long edge of bed, between bed.head and bed.foot, immediately beside bedside.
marks.intended: Along the left long edge of bed, between bed.head and bed.foot, immediately beside bedside.

marks.name: Open bedside floor
marks.size: At least a grown person lying down in length and a broad walking stride in width.
marks.where: Centre-right middle, directly left of bed.side. Kept free for approaching the wolf, helping people out of the bed, and the wolf's fall beside it.
marks.intended: Centre-right middle, directly left of bed.side. Kept free for approaching the wolf, helping people out of the bed, and the wolf's fall beside it.

marks.name: Clear central floor
marks.size: About two grown people wide, with room for three people to gather.
marks.where: Centre foreground through centre middle, joining door to table, sewing-shelf, bedside, and the clear space beyond bed.foot; no furniture crosses these routes.
marks.intended: Centre foreground through centre middle, joining door to table, sewing-shelf, bedside, and the clear space beyond bed.foot; no furniture crosses these routes.

cottage.camera: Fixed eye-level wide view from the front-centre of the room, facing the back wall. The entrance is visible on the left wall, the window and table are central, and the bed is on the right.
